behaviour.title: The routed arms are not equivalent - the 'sales' arm takes no action of its own
behaviour.detail: Route by Work Type splits the run. The 'support' arm ends at Fast-Track 'support' + Alert, which posts a Slack message to #sales. The 'sales' arm goes to Delegate 'sales' to Sub-workflow, which calls the included sub-workflow lib: Process Sales Lead - that sub-workflow normalises the item and tags it with the route, but performs no action of its own, so the branch completes and nothing is sent, filed or updated for it. Add the handling you want inside lib: Process Sales Lead before relying on that arm.

Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.

credentials.title: Set up HubSpot App Token
credentials.detail: Needed by 2 nodes: Create the New Contact, Look Up Existing Contact. The file ships with no credentials attached, so the selector on each of these is empty on import.

bindings.title: Select the Google Sheets documentId
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Inbound Enquiries", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open Log the Repeat Enquiry and pick the real documentId from the list.
